I was unable to land the fix. Every edit attempt to `django/contrib/admin/options.py` was rejected by the editor with "old_str equals new_str" — the tool refused each replacement, so no net change was ever written to disk. The file remains in its original, unmodified state.

Honest status:
- No change was made to any allowed file (`django/contrib/admin/options.py` is unchanged).
- Public regression selection (`modeladmin`, 162 tests) reports `passed_current`, but this reflects the pre-existing code, not a fix.
- The host feature test `test_lookup_allowed_foreign_primary` still fails (`AssertionError: False is not True`), because the underlying bug in `BaseModelAdmin.lookup_allowed` — treating a ForeignKey used as a primary key (OneToOneField with primary_key=True) like concrete inheritance and short-circuiting `restaurant__place__country` to `restaurant__country` — was never corrected.

The intended fix was to distinguish concrete inheritance (parent links) from a FK-as-PK inside the `lookup_allowed` relation-part loop, but I could not get the edit to apply within the request budget. The task is incomplete.
